# fptcloud_backup_native_volume_job (Resource)

Manages a volume backup job of the Backup Native service. Only FKE persistent volumes (names starting with `pv-fke`) can be backed up. Destroying the resource deletes the job; its restore points are kept and still count against the backup quota.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fptcloud_backup_native_volume_job" "data" {
  vpc_id                  = var.vpc_id
  name                    = "pv-data-daily"
  description             = "Daily backup of the FKE data volume"
  volume_ids              = [var.pv_volume_id] # an FKE persistent volume, name pv-fke-*
  notification_method_ids = [var.notification_method_id]
  retention               = 14

  schedule {
    full_backup_frequency = "daily"
    time                  = "01:30"
    time_zone             = "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the volume backup job, unique in the VPC. 2-26 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
- `notification_method_ids` (Set of String) IDs of alert notification methods that receive the job's notifications. See the `fptcloud_alert_notification_methods` data source.
- `retention` (Number) Number of restore points kept per volume, 1-1000.
- `schedule` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) When backups run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule))
- `volume_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the FKE persistent volumes to back up. A volume can belong to only one backup job.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 100 characters. Once set it cannot be removed: the API ignores an empty description.
- `schedule_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Status of the job.

<a id="nestedblock--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `full_backup_frequency` (String) `daily` runs a full backup every day. `weekly` and `monthly` run a full backup on `full_backup_day` and an incremental backup on the other days.
- `time` (String) Time of day the backup starts, `HH:MM` in `time_zone`.

Optional:

- `full_backup_day` (Number) Day of the full backup. `weekly`: 0-6, Monday is 0. `monthly`: 1-31. Required for `weekly` and `monthly`, not allowed for `daily`.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of `time`, for example `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import fptcloud_backup_native_volume_job.data vpc/<vpc_id>/backup_native_volume_job/<job_id>
```
